name: ai-problem-solving-memory
description: Problem-Solving Memory service — user-owned memory of past problem-solving experience, reusable across AIs and projects.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npm run build -w @ai-problem-solving-memory/api-client && npm run build -w @ai-problem-solving-memory/claude-code-adapter && npm run build -w @ai-problem-solving-memory/claude-code-memory-plugin
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w @ai-problem-solving-memory/api-client && npm run typecheck -w @ai-problem-solving-memory/claude-code-adapter && npm run typecheck -w @ai-problem-solving-memory/claude-code-memory-plugin
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run bundle:check && npm run test
